title: Ping Tool
summary: A network team's reachability checker blocks some dangerous characters. Not all of them.
objectives: Work out how the tool runs its check
Find and read the team's runbook on the server
learningOutcomes: Replace shell execution with argument-based APIs and allowlists

references.label: MITRE ATT&CK T1059: Command and Scripting Interpreter

hints.bodyMd: Semicolons and ampersands are blocked. A shell has other ways to chain commands.
The lab has no outbound network, so results must come back in the page. Try a pipe, and start by listing /tmp.
